identity.title: Munda cognate set with proto-Munda reconstructions
identity.creator: Felix Rau

scope.classification: comparative Munda-family lexical dataset containing Mundari among multiple languages; not Munda-ethnographic evidence

verification.canonicalization_rule: Zenodo DOI is the dataset-version work identity; CSV download, preview, mirrors and citations are manifestations, not independent corroboration.

evidence_gate.reason: Provider metadata establishes dataset identity and comparative scope, but this run did not verify an explicit reuse licence or inspect individual Mundari rows and their upstream provenance. Open access alone is not treated as redistribution permission.
requirements_before_promotion: lawfully capture and hash the CSV if redistribution/storage is permitted
extract Mundari-bearing rows deterministically with row-level locators
preserve original transcription and reconstruction notation
trace each promoted form to MKCD/Pinnow or other row-level upstream citation where supplied
do not count derived Rau rows as independent corroboration of their upstream lexical source
keep proto-Munda reconstruction claims distinct from attested Mundari forms

release_effect.note: Audit-only addition pending deterministic census reconciliation; do not alter reconciled claim/evidence/module metrics.
